caption:
Both paths get people hired. They build different kinds of proof.

A side project is fully yours. You choose the stack, you can demo it in any interview, and no client deadline can kill it. But it rarely meets real traffic, real users or a strict code review.

A second skill at work comes with a reviewer, production data and a senior to ask. It shows up in your appraisal. But it's tied to your company's stack, and you can't link it on your resume.

What would you pick, and what's driving it: your next switch, or what you want to get good at?
